origine_fr: 知 réunit 矢, la flèche, et 口, la bouche, que le Shuowen jiezi analyse tous deux comme éléments de sens. Les commentateurs expliquent que celui qui sait parle vite et juste, comme une flèche va droit au but. Le caractère signifie savoir, connaître.
origine_en: 知 brings together 矢, arrow, and 口, mouth, both read by the Shuowen jiezi as carrying meaning. Commentators explain that someone who knows speaks quickly and to the point, as an arrow flies straight to its mark. The character means to know, to be aware of.
